verdict.rationale: Weave's docs explicitly support custom Scorers that encode use-case-specific criteria beyond the built-ins. Scorers are defined as functions that take the AI output, analyze it, and return a dictionary of metrics, and they plug into the Evaluation object as one or more scoring functions. The flexible imperative evaluation API and EvaluationLogger reinforce code-driven metric logging. Missing for 10: detail on custom scorer mechanics such as class-based scorers and custom metric aggregation/summarization, and independent or hands-on corroboration of writing custom scorers.
